premises.text: Messaging forces a text-versus-voice choice: voice transcription errors and voice-only apps fail in quiet settings
premises.evidence_span: every one of these messages is either in text format or voice format

premises.text: Every Talks message always includes both text and voice so recipients can read or listen and keep original audio if transcription errs
premises.evidence_span: Talks incorporates text and voice into every message

premises.text: The app supports rich sharing to social networks and media types including pictures, video, doodles, music, and location in a simple UI
premises.evidence_span: a fully featured messaging app that supports pictures, voice, video, doodles, music, and location

premises.text: Multi-platform launch and sending to recipients who lack the app increases virality
premises.evidence_span: talks doesn't require the receiver to have the app so I can send messages literally to anyone

premises.text: Voice cloning learns the user's voice so messages and posts can be read aloud in their voice or celebrity voices
premises.evidence_span: we created a technology called voice cloning

value.text: People communicate without choosing between typing and talking because every message has both formats
value.evidence_span: you won't have to choose whether you type or talk or read or listen
